agent_explanation: Energy explosion on arena ceiling bounce with tiny dt. Body approaches ceiling at 14.99 m/s, after collision leaves at 35.07 m/s (speed more than doubles) despite e=0.7, raising energy from 219.8 to 722.7 J. Positional correction / impulse with near-zero penetration (0.002) and dt=0.00035 injects velocity: correction velocity ~ penetration/dt. Larger dt restores energy loss.
